s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity
salient_findings: Rigidity of axial and appendicular muscles
Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT
key_facts: HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B and C serologies negative
ANA, anticardiolipin, ANCA, and T-spot negative
Brain CT showed a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum
MRI revealed a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity
salient_findings: Rigidity of axial and appendicular muscles
Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on brain CT
key_facts: HIV, syphilis, hepatitis B and C serologies negative
ANA, anticardiolipin, ANCA, and T-spot negative
Brain CT showed a hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum
MRI revealed a homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body

shortlist.label: Glioblastoma multiforme
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the corpus callosum body with rim enhancement on MRI

shortlist.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Homogeneous mass in the corpus callosum body with surrounding vasogenic edema

shortlist.label: Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive alteration of mental status with immobility and rigidity

shortlist.label: Toxoplasmosis
shortlist.why_kept: Hypodense lesion in the corpus callosum on Brain CT, although HIV serology is negative

shortlist.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive neurological decline with a mass in the corpus callosum body

raw.rationale: The patient's rapid progression to a vegetative state, rigidity, and myoclonus-like signs (positive Babinski and Chaddock signs) are consistent with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease, a prion disease characterized by rapidly progressive dementia and neurological decline.

rejected.label: Glioblastoma multiforme
rejected.why: Typically presents with more focal neurological deficits and a slower progression

rejected.label: Primary central nervous system lymphoma
rejected.why: Often associated with immunocompromised state, which is not indicated in this patient

rejected.label: Toxoplasmosis
rejected.why: Typically presents with fever, headache, and focal neurological deficits, and is more common in immunocompromised patients

rejected.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
rejected.why: Almost exclusively occurs in immunocompromised patients and presents with focal neurological deficits
